lyrics:
[SCENE START: LIVE FROM THE STRATOSPHERE CORRIDOR OF SATURN]
[AUDIO: CRACKLING RADIO CARRIER WAVE WITH DRY CLOSE-MIKED BANJO STRUMS AND CONSTANT SUB-HARMONIC HUMMING]
[ANCHOR SETUP: URGENT TABLOID NEWS SPECIAL AT ELEVEN BROADCASTING ACROSS ALL FREQUENCIES AND DISTORTED MODULATION CHANNELS]

[SPOKEN TABLOID ANCHOR]
Good evening, citizens of the magnificent ring-system! Tonight we bring you absolutely catastrophic updates from the edge of the known cosmos!
The classification protocol has failed entirely! The taxonomy is leaking through the floorboards of the physical universe!
According to our deepest subterranean sensors, the true nature of reality is missing a crucial rivet and nobody can find the toolbox!
Let's go straight to the field reporter hovering precariously outside the inner vortex where the weather is completely made of legal documents!

[FIELD REPORT: FRANTIC TABLOID SPEECH-SONG WITH FAST ACCORDION PATTER AND UNSTABLE RHYTHMIC COUNTER-MELODIES]
[SPEED UP: 7/8 BALKAN METRIC PULSE WITH ERRATIC PERCUSSIVE ACCENTS]
We are standing directly over the great hexagonal storm of perpetual bureaucratic nightmares!
And folks, the air is not made of standard atmospheric air anymore! It has been completely replaced!
It is made of unverified bureaucratic paperwork, damp carbon paper, and thousands of old grocery receipts!
Every passing cloud is officially categorized as a severe administrative error or a filing misdemeanor!
We checked the central ledger and the ancient ledger checked us back with a look of profound disappointment!
Listen to the carrier hiss! Listen to the severe signal attenuation as the stratosphere begins to buckle and tear!

[WITNESS INTERVIEW: HIGH YODEL REGISTER FLIP AND NASAL DRONE HARMONY WITH RAPID TREMOLO STRINGS]
[WITNESS]
I saw the gaping hole right there in the middle of the sky!
It looked precisely like a missing decimal point in a multi-billion-dollar corporate budget!
My favorite shoes suddenly turned into old radio waves and walked away from me all by themselves!
They didn't even stop to say goodbye or explain their sudden departure from my feet!

[CHOIR SHOUTS: MASS THEATRICAL ACCENT WITH HEAVY STOMP PERCUSSION AND SHARP METALIC CLANGS]
[STOP-START PUNK RHYTHM WITH UNYIELDING SYNCOPATION]
Taxonomic contagion! Systemic mutation across the board!
Nobody leaves the ring alive without a proper classification card and a signed waiver from the void!

[NITROUS MEMBRANE POP: SUDDEN LOW-FREQUENCY WARBLE AND DEEP SUB-BASS RUMBLE THAT SHAKES THE FOUNDATION]
[ALTERED STATE THRESHOLD REACHED: REALITY BRIEFLY STRIPPED OF ALL COLOR AND REDUCED TO MONOCHROME STATIC]
[SPOKEN SLOW DRONE]
Wait a minute. The broadcasting room is exactly the same physical size, but the walls are now made entirely of yesterday's weather forecasts.
We are currently broadcasting from deep inside an open vowel sound.
An endless open vowel with no consonants whatsoever to anchor the sagging ceiling or hold the corners together.
Hold on just a second. The studio microphone is staring directly at us with a look of existential dread.

[RESEAL REALITY: SNAPPING BACK TO DRY BANJO DRONE AND RAPID CABARET PATTER WITH DIZZYING MODULATION]
[EXPERT SPECULATION: COMPLEX POLYPHONIC VOCAL COUNTERPOINT WITH COMPETING ACADEMIC THEORIES]
[EXPERT]
As you can clearly see from the glowing holographic graph of the impending disaster projected behind me,
the entire holographic universe is fraying rapidly at the absolute margin of its containment field!
If the great Saturnian storm crosses the critical threshold parameter within the next twelve minutes,
every single noun in existence will completely dissolve into an unregulated active verb!
You won't even be a recognized person anymore; you will just be a poorly scheduled dental appointment!

[CATASTROPHIC ANTICIPATION: ACCELERATING TEMPO AND RISING PITCH CLUSTERS THAT PIERCE THE EARDUMS]
[SPOKEN RAPIDLY]
Prepare the emergency shelters immediately! Fasten your emergency antennas securely! The primary carrier wave is dropping fast!
We are running dangerously out of bandwidth! The signal is splitting into three distinct dimensions simultaneously!
Look closely at the data stream! Look at the sheer scale of the cosmic scandal! It's happening right before our eyes!

[DRAMATIC REENACTMENT: RAPID SCAT SYLLABLES AS PERCUSSION ALONG WITH FAINT DISTANT SIRENS]
Bip-bop-taxonomy-drop! Click-clack-file-the-lock! Who authorized this procedural review?
Nobody knows what specific category we belong to in the grand cosmic filing cabinet anymore!
Are we conscious mammals? Are we forgotten radio towers? Are we just falling space debris burning up?

[NEW EVIDENCE: HIGH-PITCHED SQUEAL AND SUDDEN RADIO STATIC BURST WITH DISQUIETING REVERBERATION]
[ANCHOR INTERRUPT]
Breaking news bulletin! We have just received urgent word directly from the upper rings!
The fundamental sub-atomic particles have formed an interstellar union and gone on an indefinite strike!
All physical constants have been temporarily suspended pending binding arbitration from the high council!

[PHASE BANSHEE: THRESHOLD CATASTROPHE AND MASSIVE HARMONIC SHIFT WITH EAR-SPLITTING VOLUME]
[CHORAL EXPLOSION: FULL ACCORDION, BANJO, AND BOWED METAL DRONE COLLIDING IN GLORIOUS DISCORD]
[SUNG IN MASSIVE BARBERSHOP HARMONY WITH DELAYED CADENTIAL RELEASE AND LOUD STATIC CRACKLE]
Everything you thought you knew is fundamentally wrong! Everything you own is filed completely incorrectly!
The great void is currently broadcasting on AM frequency ninety-eight point four with maximum power!
Tune your emergency dials! Save your faded receipts! The headline is eating the paper alive from the inside out!

[OUTRO: RAPID FADE THROUGH HEAVY RADIO STATIC, CRACKLING CARRIER HISS, AND DISTANT DRONE]
[END SCENE]
